items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: All I had Xavier Cugat's band do during our four weeks stay was on the end, when we finished playing, was to hit the chord.

ctx.x: So I had two clarinets, a muted trumpet, and a trombone, and played light things for Lena, and it swung. And All I had Xavier Cugat's band do during our four weeks stay was on the end, when we finished playing, was to hit the chord.
